primitives.name: Ball Curvature
primitives.verbatim_quote: 180 WALTER CAMP'S BOOK OF COLLEGE SPORTS was to the use of the wrist in the delivery, making what was known as an underhand throw.
primitives.assumptions: Incompressible fluid flow around a spinning sphere, negligible drag coefficient.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Stokes flow regime where Reynolds number is very low.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Pitch trajectory posterior distribution. GSE: State-transition probability matrix for pitch type.
layer2.telemetry: Pitcher's wrist angular velocity and spin axis orientation.

primitives.name: Optical Delusion Skepticism
primitives.verbatim_quote: For a long time men versed in physical science and phenomena pooh-poohed at this, saying that it was impossible, and that it was simply an optical delusion.
primitives.assumptions: Classical mechanics with Euclidean geometry, no relativistic corrections.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Deterministic predictability fails when initial conditions are imprecisely measured.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Prior belief distribution over physical laws. GSE: Decision actor models classical physics as baseline hypothesis.
layer2.telemetry: Historical betting odds on scientific consensus shifts.

primitives.name: Air Compression Deflection
primitives.verbatim_quote: The most logical explanation of the curvature of a ball depends upon the supposition of the compression of the air just in front of the ball and a corresponding rarefaction immediately behind it, so that the ball by its friction is deflected from its true course.
primitives.assumptions: Bernoulli's principle applied to inviscid flow, constant density assumption near sonic speeds.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Flow separation occurs at high angles of attack, invalidating potential flow theory.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Conformal map from physical space to complex potential plane. GSE: Transition kernel for aerodynamic states.
layer2.telemetry: Pressure differential measurements across the ball surface.

primitives.name: Curve Mastering Tendency
primitives.verbatim_quote: When the curves were mastered, the tendency of the pitchers was to bring the hand up above the hip in order to give more of a twist to the ball, and thereby assist the curve.
primitives.assumptions: Rigid body dynamics with fixed pivot point at the shoulder joint.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Kinematic singularity when the arm angle approaches vertical, requiring joint torque regularization.

layer2.mapping: GSI: Rule-based prior constraints on allowable pitch trajectories. GSE: Hierarchical policy network with action-space pruning.
layer2.telemetry: Umpire strike zone accuracy metrics before and after rule change.
